name: EQ chorus dual-delay multi-algo reverb FX chain
goal: Finish a cinematic patch with the Traveler-style FX order: 3-band EQ → multi-type chorus → dual/ping-pong modulated delay → room/hall/space reverb (long space tails).

source.title: TRAVELER: The Cinematic Hybrid Synthesizer | Official Walkthrough

prerequisites: Hybrid synth or Traveler-inspired Web Audio engine with multi-osc, stereo filter, envelopes, LFOs/mod matrix, sequenced control tracks (or automation), and FX (EQ/chorus/delay/reverb)

outputs.name: fx_finished_patch
outputs.description: Mix-ready cinematic FX chain on original patch

constraints: Original synthesis only; not affiliated with KeySolutions; do not rip Traveler samples/presets/wavetables.
Original synthesis only — design new patches from portable parameters; do not copy proprietary Traveler factory preset names, banks, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with KeySolutions Sounds or Traveler; concepts mapped to generic hybrid-synth / Web Audio equivalents.
Do not rip, dump, or redistribute Traveler content.
Prefer recreating the described signal-flow and motion relationships in our browser music system or any hybrid synth with comparable modules.
Do not download or redistribute KeyTIME/KeySPACE plugin content; recreate delay/reverb motion with stock or original Web Audio FX.

steps.action: Insert 3-band EQ first: sculpt low end, mid presence, and highs so the synth sits in a mix before time FX.
Add chorus: choose type 1, type 2, or combined. Keep wet modest for cinematic width without seasick detune.
Dual or ping-pong stereo modulated delay: independent L/R times, feedback, stereo spread, feedback filters, and classic delay modulation.
steps.expect: Tempo-friendly echoes that stay filtered in the mix

steps.action: Reverb: pick room, hall, or space algorithm (space can reach very long tails). Set size/decay/predelay manually with original settings.
steps.expect: Depth without washing out attack unless intentional

steps.action: Map portable names: KeyTIME-like = tempo-synced modulated delay motion; KeySPACE-like = multi-algo cinematic reverb. Keep FX after synth engine; watch limiter on main out.
steps.expect: Clear FX order and safe peaks

verification: Delay L/R independence or ping-pong audible
Reverb algo matches intended space size
